author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮೊಗೆದುಪಡೆ ರತ್ನಗಳ ನಿನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಗುಣಗಳಿವೆ
ನಗದಂತೆ ತೊಟ್ಟುನಡೆ ನಿನಗದುವೆ ಕವಚ
ಸೊಗವಹುದು ಸಜ್ಜನಿಕೆ ಉಜ್ಜಗಿಸೆ ಬದುಕಿನಲಿ
ಮೊಗವೆತ್ತಿ ನಡೆಯುವೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Draw them up like gems: there are virtues within you;
wear them like jewellery as you walk; they are your armour;
goodness is beauty when it shines in life;
you will walk with your head held high, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The virtues within us are jewels. Wear them openly, let them protect you, and you will walk with dignity.
